prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: miniature decorative tailoring illustration for a boutique website, displayed at only 80px. Create ONE isolated object group on a genuinely transparent background, square composition. Style: refined tactile editorial still-life illustration, crisp organic edges, restrained realistic paper/fabric texture, subtle soft dimensional shading, no heavy cast shadow. The palette is warm Ivory #F9F0E3, Royal Plum #47162F, Dusty Rose #C88B96 and restrained Antique Gold #BE9A63. Strong simple silhouette readable at small sizes, subject fills about 80 percent of the canvas, generous unclipped edges. Flat-lay view. This is a conceptual studio object, not a finished garment or product photograph. No background panel, no white rectangle, no checkerboard, no surface, no border, no labels, no letters, no watermark, no logo, no hands, no flowers, no sparkles. Subject: one small ivory paper tailoring pattern piece shaped like a blouse bodice, with a crisp Royal Plum edge and just two fine dart/cut lines. Slightly angled, minimal and elegant. No fabric, no pencil, no scissors, no measuring tape. The paper outline should remain visible on an ivory website surface.
